title: Objective
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a quantitative, time-bounded milestone derived from a Goal. Objectives make Goals measurable and trackable, bridging strategic intent (Goal) to operational requirements (ArchitectureRequirement). Rootless — an Objective is a measurement target, not an active system. TOGAF mapping: Objective (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision). Source framework: TOGAF (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision).

measureType.description: How the objective is measured. QUANTITATIVE = numeric target (e.g., 99.9% uptime). QUALITATIVE = assessed against criteria. BINARY = achieved or not. TOGAF mapping: Objective measurement approach.

timeframe.description: Target timeframe for achieving the objective. ISO 8601 duration (e.g., P1Y = 1 year, P6M = 6 months).

status.description: Objective lifecycle status. TOGAF mapping: Objective tracking in Architecture Vision / Governance.

description.description: Human-readable description of the objective and its success criteria.
